test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The erroneously spelt word is '**Taccal**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Taccal**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Tackle**'. • It means 'to make an effort to deal with a difficult situation or problem'. (कठिन स्थिति या समस्‍या का हल निकालने का प्रयास करना) • *Example: The government must **tackle** the problem of rising unemployment.* **Correct Answer:__** *Taccal.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Metal**: a type of solid substance that is usually hard and shiny and that heat and electricity can travel through. (विद्युत तथा ताप का अवशोषक कठोर चमकीला ठोस पदार्थ, धातु) • **Brutal**: very cruel and/or violent. (अति क्रूर और/या हिंसापूर्ण; पाशविक, अमानुषिक) • **Fatal**: causing or ending in death. (घातक; जिससे अंत में मृत्‍यु हो जाए, जानलेवा) 32:T9f8, The correct answer is '**Dictatorial**'.
